rule_notes.color-contrast: [2026-04-25] Translucent sticky surfaces fail contrast against bleed-through content (dashboard hero, sticky table headers). Will be addressed in PR-1 mobile chrome (opaque surfaces). See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-25-mobile-chrome-and-haggle-design.md.
rule_notes.scrollable-region-focusable: [2026-04-25] MarginTable scroll containers need keyboard focus. Will be addressed in PR-1 mobile chrome (mobile card layout) or a Tier 2 cleanup.
rule_notes.aria-required-parent: [2026-04-25] MarginTable header row uses role=row + role=columnheader on a div-grid layout (not a real <table>). Wrapping in role=grid breaks aria-required-children because the empty-state / loading slots use role=status. Proper fix is either to convert MarginTable to a semantic <table> or to drop the role=* attrs and rely on aria-sort buttons alone. Slated for PR-1 mobile chrome card layout cleanup.
